title: GPU Gray-QAM soft demap integration
description:
## Goal

Integrate the existing `gf2-kernels-hip::demap_batch` Gray-QAM
soft-demap kernel as a `Stage` in the gf2-sim pipeline.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline)
within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] GPU demap LLRs match CPU `FastGrayQamDemapper` output
  to documented FP tolerance for 16-QAM and 64-QAM at fixed
  channel realisation.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: receipt records GPU demap
  throughput vs CPU baseline on gfx1030.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
